Disaggregate univariate or multivariate time series from low to high frequency

disagg.Rd

Disaggregate univariate or multivariate time series from low to high frequency

Usage

disagg(
  x,
  conv_type = "mean",
  target_freq = "quarter",
  pattern = NULL,
  extend_with = NULL
)

Arguments

x

a ts-boxable object at a low frequency (e.g. annual or quarterly)

conv_type

match the interpolated value via "first", "last", "sum", "mean". If conv_type == "uhero" then the name of the time series x is compared to the internal variable sum_pattern. For matching series names the interpolation is based on "sum"; for all others it is based on "mean."

target_freq

target frequency "quarter" (default) or "month"

pattern

a single high-frequency pattern that the interpolation should follow; it serves every series in x

extend_with

NULL (default), "last_growth", or a ts-boxable object. Without a pattern the interpolation has nothing to follow at the end of a series and bends toward zero growth over the last periods (and the first). "last_growth" first continues each series at its last growth rate for three periods; a series (one per series in x, with the same names, or a single one for a single x) continues x with its growth at both ends, wherever it reaches beyond x. The result is cut back to x's own periods.

Value

interpolated object of the same type as the input

Details

Leading and trailing NAs of x are dropped, so the result ends at the last period with data. An NA inside a series is an error. Where the pattern covers less than x, tempdisagg drops the periods of x outside the pattern, with a message.

Examples

quarterly_data_example |>
  disagg(conv_type = "mean", target_freq = "month") |>
  dplyr::select(1:4) |>
  head(4)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 4
#>   time       E_NF_HI ECT_HI EMN_HI
#>   <date>       <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 1998-01-01    530.   23.3   15.9
#> 2 1998-02-01    530.   23.3   15.9
#> 3 1998-03-01    531.   23.2   15.9
#> 4 1998-04-01    531.   23.1   15.8
# the monthly values average back to the original quarters
quarterly_data_example |>
  disagg(conv_type = "mean", target_freq = "month") |>
  tsbox::ts_long() |>
  tsbox::ts_frequency(to = "quarter", aggregate = "mean") |>
  tsbox::ts_wide() |>
  dplyr::select(1:4) |>
  head(2)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>   time       E_NF_HI ECT_HI EMN_HI
#>   <date>       <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 1998-01-01    531.   23.3   15.9
#> 2 1998-04-01    531.   23.0   15.8
# works with a single series too
quarterly_data_example |>
  tsbox::ts_long() |>
  tsbox::ts_pick("E_NF_HI") |>
  disagg(conv_type = "mean", target_freq = "month") |>
  tsbox::ts_plot()

# using a high-frequency pattern
quarterly_data_example |>
  tsbox::ts_long() |>
  tsbox::ts_span("2005-01-01", "2020-01-01") |>
  disagg(
    conv_type = "mean", target_freq = "month", pattern = monthly_data_example |>
      tsbox::ts_long() |>
      tsbox::ts_pick("VISNS_HI")
  ) |>
  head(4)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 3
#>   id      time       value
#>   <chr>   <date>     <dbl>
#> 1 E_NF_HI 2005-01-01  594.
#> 2 E_NF_HI 2005-02-01  594.
#> 3 E_NF_HI 2005-03-01  597.
#> 4 E_NF_HI 2005-04-01  599.
# multiple low-frequency series, same number of high-frequency patterns
purrr::map2(
  quarterly_data_example |>
    tsbox::ts_long() |>
    tsbox::ts_pick("E_NF_HI", "ECT_HI") |>
    tsbox::ts_span("2005-01-01", "2020-01-01") |>
    tsbox::ts_tslist(),
  monthly_data_example |>
    tsbox::ts_long() |>
    tsbox::ts_pick("VISNS_HI", "VAPNS_HI") |>
    tsbox::ts_long() |>
    tsbox::ts_tslist(),
  ~ disagg(.x, conv_type = "mean", target_freq = "month", pattern = .y) |>
    head(3)
)
#> Additional [id] column(s): 'id'
#> $E_NF_HI
#>           Jan      Feb      Mar
#> 2005 593.5753 594.4022 596.6407
#> 
#> $ECT_HI
#>           Jan      Feb      Mar
#> 2005 32.07939 32.25980 32.74226
#> 
# the last year without and with an extension
a <- make_xts(2015, val = 100 * 1.02^(0:10))
disagg(a) |> tsbox::ts_pc() |> tail(4)
#>                value
#> 2025-01-01 0.6174512
#> 2025-04-01 0.4602231
#> 2025-07-01 0.3053787
#> 2025-10-01 0.1521779
disagg(a, extend_with = "last_growth") |> tsbox::ts_pc() |> tail(4)
#>                value
#> 2025-01-01 0.4944892
#> 2025-04-01 0.4968292
#> 2025-07-01 0.4991225
#> 2025-10-01 0.5013695
